sources_note: Official names, descriptions and grades as listed by Exophase (Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophies) and PSNProfiles (Grand Theft Auto VI trophies), which agree on all 55. Guides below are written for this entry from those official descriptions; where a description is vague, the guide says what it implies and cites the GTA Wiki trophy coverage instead of inventing steps.

stages.summary: Play the main story from Gone Fishing through the final mission. Every chapter and named-mission trophy unlocks on the way; none of them can be missed if you finish the story.
stages.title: Story playthrough

stages.summary: Finish the mission strands for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone, plus eight stranger strands across Leonida, and Bret's unique-animal hunt. Do these before the final mission if a strand's contact is tied to the story.
stages.title: Strangers and side strands

stages.summary: Meditation spots, collectible card sets, WAiNK locations, discovering vehicles, and exploring every area of Leonida. Best done with the whole map open after Chapter 3.
stages.title: Collectibles and exploration

stages.summary: Stunts, shooting range golds, races, drone races, fishing, arcade, bowling, challenges, robberies and the money trophies. Grind these in any order once the map is open.
stages.title: Activities and challenges

stages.summary: Mop up anything left, reach 100% completion for the gold, and the platinum unlocks when the other 54 are earned.
stages.title: Cleanup to 100% and platinum

trophies.guide: The platinum: earn the other 54 trophies on this list. It unlocks automatically the moment the last one pops, so treat it as the end of Stage 5 cleanup rather than a target of its own. Nothing here is missable by itself — the risk lives in the missable-flagged trophies below, so clear those first.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.guide: Complete Gone Fishing, the opening mission. It is the first thing the game asks of you, so this bronze is effectively unmissable — just play the introduction to its end. If it has not popped, you have not finished the opening sequence yet.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1 of the story. Chapter trophies unlock as the chapter's final mission ends, so keep following the main story markers until the game moves you into Chapter 2. Story progress cannot be skipped, so this cannot be missed on a completed playthrough.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 2. As with Chapter 1, the trophy lands when the chapter wraps up and Chapter 3 begins. Keep a manual save at the start of each chapter anyway — not for this trophy, but so a missable moment later in the chapter can be replayed without restarting the game.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 3. By this point most of Leonida should be open to you, which makes it a good moment to start the Stage 3 collectibles in parallel. The trophy itself is story-locked and unmissable.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 4. Chapter 4 is the last numbered chapter before the finale, so once this pops only the final mission stands between you and the story gold. Before starting that finale, finish any stranger strands whose contacts the story may retire — see Stage 2.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.guide: Complete the final story mission. This gold marks the end of the main story; the open world stays available afterwards for cleanup. Because endings can change which contacts remain available, clear the Stage 2 strands first if you are worried about a strand disappearing — the trophy itself cannot be missed.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. Named-mission trophies like this one unlock at the mission's end screen, so simply play the mission through when the story offers it. It sits on the main path and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Trust
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. Heist missions usually have a setup phase before the job itself — the trophy waits for the heist to conclude, not for the setup. Stock up on armor and ammunition beforehand; failing and retrying does not affect the trophy.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Play it when the story marker appears and finish it to the end screen. Like the other named missions, it is on the critical path and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Family Matters
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Follow the main story until this mission is offered, then play it through. Unmissable on a finished playthrough.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown. The name ties it to the VCIA location that also features in Catch Me If You Can (id 37) — while you are in that area for the story, keep the missable-flagged trophy in mind. This mission trophy itself is unmissable.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. Play the main story until it appears and finish it. Unmissable — it is part of the critical path toward the finale.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion on the in-game completion tracker. That means the story, the stranger strands, the activities and the collectibles the tracker counts — use the game's own stats screen to see what remains rather than guessing. This gold is the natural end of Stage 5; pair it with the checklist here, since most 100% requirements overlap with other trophies on this list.
trophies.name: A Long Road
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts in total. The description gives the count only, so treat every stunt opportunity the game registers — jumps and stunt events — as progress, and check the in-game stats to see your running total. It is a long grind: chip away at it during Stage 3 exploration instead of saving all 250 for the end.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once — the starter list counts 9 activity types. You only need to start (and finish) each one a single time, not master it, which makes this a quick early trophy once activities unlock. If it does not pop, one type is still untried; the in-game activity menu shows which.
trophies.name: Master of None
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge — 42 in total, per the tracked count on the official list. Work through the range's challenge list weapon by weapon, and replay any challenge that ends below gold; medals are kept per challenge, so progress is never lost. Leave this until you have a steady aim setup you like, then clear it in one sitting.
trophies.name: The Shootist
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every location — 14 locations in total. A win at each site is required, not just taking part, so learn each course and re-run any race you lose. Tick locations off here as you win them; the tracker in this guide is built for exactly that.
trophies.name: Top Fun
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. 'Different' is the catch: winning the same race 20 times does not count, so rotate through the race list and keep track of which ones you have won. A tuned vehicle makes the later races far less painful.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal's fishing challenge, take it on, and out-fish him — the trophy needs the win, not just an attempt. If you lose, the challenge can be retried, so treat the first run as practice for the timing.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game from start to finish. Walk up to any arcade cabinet the game lets you play and finish the game it offers — 'complete' means reaching its end, not just starting it. This is one of the quickest trophies on the list once you find a cabinet.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Andy's strand. Work through Andy's missions in order until the strand ends; the trophy waits for the last one, not the first. Treat it as missable until proven otherwise: side contacts can be retired by story events, so finish Andy's strand before the final story mission rather than after it.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
GTA Wiki — Grand Theft Auto VI missions coverage

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Kenton's strand. Follow Kenton's missions to their conclusion; earlier missions in the strand do not count toward this trophy. As with Andy's strand, do it before the story finale in case Kenton becomes unavailable afterwards.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
GTA Wiki — Grand Theft Auto VI missions coverage

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Billy's strand. Play Billy's missions in order until the strand closes out. Flagged missable here for the same reason as the other contact strands: finish it during Stage 2, before the final story mission, so a story change cannot lock it away.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
GTA Wiki — Grand Theft Auto VI missions coverage

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. A 'strand' is a stranger's whole chain of missions, so finishing one stranger's first job is not enough — see each chain through. The named-contact trophies (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) overlap with this silver, so clearing Stage 2 strands moves both at once. Some strangers only appear at certain times or after certain chapters, so sweep the map again after each chapter.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
GTA Wiki — Grand Theft Auto VI strangers coverage

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Randy's strand. Work Randy's missions in order until the last one is done. Treat as missable: clear it before the final story mission, alongside the other contact strands in Stage 2.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
GTA Wiki — Grand Theft Auto VI missions coverage

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Tyrone's strand. Follow Tyrone's chain of missions to its end. Like the other named strands, finish it in Stage 2 rather than risking it after the story finale.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
GTA Wiki — Grand Theft Auto VI missions coverage

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every meditation spot across Leonida — 18 spots in total. Each spot only needs one meditation, so this is a pure map sweep: work region by region once the whole state is open and tick spots off as you go. Nothing here is time-limited, so it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. This is tied to Bret, so it likely sits inside or beside his strand: take his hunting task when offered and bring down the specific animal he names, rather than any animal you meet. Because it depends on a contact, do it during Stage 2 in case Bret's availability changes with the story.
trophies.name: Fair Game
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
GTA Wiki — Grand Theft Auto VI activities coverage

trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are gathered across Leonida and grouped into sets; the trophy needs three full sets, not three cards. Check the in-game collection screen to see which sets are closest to completion and hunt the missing cards for those first.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 locations. The count is the whole requirement: 100 separate locations, so make a habit of using it whenever you reach a new spot during Stage 3 exploration. Track your running total in the in-game stats so the last few do not turn into guesswork.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges are the game's tracked side objectives; any 50 of them count, so pick the ones that fit how you already play and let the rest go. The in-game challenge list shows your progress — use it to find the quickest remaining ones near the end.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level while with your partner and escape the heat. Build the wanted level up to four stars with your partner present, then break line of sight and stay hidden until the stars clear. The partner requirement is the part players miss — a solo escape does not count.
trophies.name: Hot Together
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level in between. Plan a route of three nearby shops, rob them in one continuous run, and keep the police interested the whole way — if the wanted level drops to zero mid-route, the chain breaks and you start again. Have a fast car waiting outside the third shop.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Discovery is about variety, not ownership: get into (or otherwise register) 100 different vehicles as you explore. Traffic changes by district and time of day, so varied driving across Leonida fills this faster than grinding one street.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during a single use of Combat Focus. Set it up somewhere enemies bunch together — a gang operation or a story shootout — and spend the whole Combat Focus window on targets you can finish, not on repositioning. If the window ends at four, the count resets, so reload and retry rather than hoping the next fight lines up.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — in plain terms, leave the VCIA site in a way the game did not schedule for you. The description is deliberately vague, so this guide does not invent a route: the cited trophy coverage is the place to confirm the exact trigger. Treat it as missable until confirmed, and try it while the VCIA Takedown story mission (id 12) has you in the area.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
GTA Wiki — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy coverage

trophies.guide: The description — 'Kinda hot in these Rhinos' — points at the Rhino tank: get into one and survive whatever the game throws at a stolen tank. The exact trigger is not spelled out in the official text, so check the cited trophy coverage before assuming. Flagged missable here because tank access may be tied to a specific mission or wanted-level state; attempt it when a Rhino is actually available to you.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
GTA Wiki — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy coverage

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Stealth is the whole trophy: if anyone spots you mid-robbery it fails, so approach quietly, deal with cameras and witnesses the way the game allows, and leave clean. Retry freely — a detected attempt costs nothing but time.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one. The escape matters as much as the robbery: a vault job that ends in arrest does not count. Five separate vaults are needed, so plan escape routes and keep a fast vehicle nearby; tick each vault off here as you clear it.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Stop the truck, take the money, and lose the wanted level afterwards — both halves are required. Armored trucks appear in traffic, so keep an eye out while driving and strike when one is isolated from police.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — 52 areas in total. Every named area needs at least a visit, so drive the map region by region and watch the area names change as you cross borders. Pair this sweep with the meditation spots (id 28) and WAiNK locations (id 31) to clear three collectible trophies in one pass.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang — 9 gangs in total, one operation each. The variety is the requirement, so note which gang each operation belongs to before you hit it and tick gangs off here as you go. Expect a fight at every site; bring armor and a full magazine.
trophies.name: Pest Control
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The description names the place and the act but not the venue, so this guide does not guess one: head to Ocean Beach, find where the game lets you order a drink with a view, and take the prompt. Flagged missable only until the trigger is confirmed — if it is a free-roam interaction it can be done any time; check the cited coverage to be sure.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
GTA Wiki — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy coverage

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — drive a showroom vehicle out through the glass, the way the series has always let you. The 'classic style' wording suggests the exit itself is the trigger, so take a car from inside a showroom and leave through the window rather than the door. Confirm the exact showroom against the cited coverage; flagged missable in case a showroom interior is only reachable during a mission.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
GTA Wiki — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy coverage

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play bowling at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and follow through — the description's wording points at completing a game there rather than just entering. Visit the alley, start a game, and finish it. If a single game does not pop it, check the cited coverage for whether a specific result (such as a strike or a win) is required.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
GTA Wiki — Grand Theft Auto VI activities coverage

trophies.guide: The official description — 'A partnership with mass appeal' — is a riddle rather than an instruction, and this guide will not invent an answer for it. It reads like a partner-activity moment (compare Hot Together, id 33, and Retail Therapy, id 34, which also involve your partner). Use the cited trophy coverage to pin down the trigger, and treat it as missable until then, since partner moments can be story-bound.
trophies.name: Personal Best
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
GTA Wiki — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy coverage

trophies.guide: Make choices — PlayStation tracks this one to a count of 500, per the official list's tracked progress. It accumulates from the decisions the game puts in front of you across the story and side content, so it fills naturally as you play rather than through any single action. If it is short near the end, keep playing side content; choices keep coming.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.guide: 'Second time's the charm' implies failing at something once and succeeding on the retry — but the official text does not say what. This guide does not guess: check the cited trophy coverage for the exact activity before spending attempts. Flagged missable because a retry-based trigger can depend on a specific event; if it turns out to be any failed-then-passed challenge, it is safe to leave for Stage 4.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
GTA Wiki — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy coverage

trophies.guide: 'What the hell just happened?' is the list's most cryptic description — it reads like witnessing a strange event or easter egg somewhere in Leonida. No location is named in the official text, so none is invented here: the cited trophy coverage is where the trigger is documented. Treat it as missable until confirmed, since one-off events are exactly the kind of thing a story can move past.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
GTA Wiki — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy coverage

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone over with a melee drive-by: swing a melee weapon from a moving vehicle and connect with a person on foot. The bowling pun in the name is about the knockdown, not the bowling alley. A slow pass along a busy sidewalk makes the timing far easier than a full-speed swing.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering marked bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from the game's robbery economy, and your contacts are the laundering route — the trophy counts earnings from laundering, not the face value you hand over. Keep laundering after every big score and the total builds on its own; check the in-game stats for your running figure.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Every purchase counts toward one shared total, so vehicle work, weapons, clothes and property-related shopping all feed it. By late game this usually completes on its own; if it is short, one expensive vehicle purchase closes the gap.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties — 8 in total. Garages are bought through the property system as they become available, so check the property listings after each chapter in case new ones unlock with the story. This is a money sink: leave it until your laundering and robbery income (ids 52 and 40) is flowing.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Open the app on your in-game phone and register vehicles you own or have access to until the count reaches ten — variety is not required by the description, only the registrations. Pair it with Whip It Good (id 35): vehicles you discover for that trophy are natural candidates to register here.
trophies.name: On the Spot
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
